title: The contractor’s own money to a committee of the office that approved its contract
question: Leaving officers aside: does an organization named as the contractor on a notice give, in its own name, to a committee of the official or board that approved the contract, inside the period the ban covers?
finding: Rarely. Campaign filings from 2017 to 2026 hold 6 contributions from an organization whose name is the contractor’s on a notice to a committee of the approving office (a supervisor’s candidate committee, or a committee carrying the approving officer’s surname); 2 fall from 180 days before to 365 days after an approval and 1 in the 365 days after one, where the calendar alone would put about 0.2 inside. The largest by far: Autodesk gave $75,000 on 2026-03-18 to “Daniel Lurie Ballot Measure Committee - Safe, Affordable MUNI for a Thriving San Francisco”, 232 days after the Mayor’s approval dated 2025-07-29 (notice filed 2025-08-22).
how: The contributor’s name on Schedule A (an organization, not an individual) must equal the contractor’s name on a notice after removing punctuation and company suffixes; the committee must be a supervisor’s candidate committee for a Board approval, or carry the approving officer’s surname for an approval by the Mayor or another officer. Days run from the nearest approval by that office. The clause printed in City agreements names the committees covered, among them “a committee controlled by such elected official or a candidate for that office”, and the contracts covered, among them those “for the sale or lease of any land or building”. Public bodies named as contractors are left out. The expected count is built as in the previous screen.
limits: For the four ballot-measure committees carrying a Mayor’s name (FPPC 1464249, 1471023, 1479782 and 1489257) the statement of organization (Form 410) is on disk and names the Mayor as controlling officeholder (screen committee-control-on-form-410); for other committees control is not shown by these files. Whether a lease in which the City is the landlord, or a contract below $100,000 in a fiscal year, is inside the rule is for the Ethics Commission. Committee names are those in force when the data was saved and may have changed since the contribution. A company may also have asked for advice or a waiver that these files do not hold. Exact-name matching misses a parent, a subsidiary or a political committee giving for the contractor.
